title: A Visit to the Library
text:
Every Saturday morning, Marcus walks to the library with his little sister. She always runs ahead to the picture books, while he heads straight for the shelf of adventure stories near the window.
The library is quiet, but it is not silent. Pages turn. A chair scrapes softly. Somewhere behind the shelves, a librarian pushes a trolley of returned books.
Marcus has a rule: he may borrow three books, but he must finish them before the next Saturday. It is not always easy. Last week he stayed up far too late, reading under his blanket with a torch, because he simply had to know how the story ended.
